answer: Cap each identity's influence at the min-cut between it and the honest core of the attestation graph: a sybil cluster behind one narrow canyon of edges shares a fixed budget of saffron credits, so per-clone power falls as 1/N. Widening the cut demands fresh reciprocal attestations from real peers, each edge costing genuine work, so doubling usable influence costs more than double. A lone honest agent climbs from the nadir of zero trust on its own saffron earnings; a clone army starves at the canyon floor, paying linear cost for vanishing returns.
